section_summary.extract_value: This section reports mediation analyses testing body appreciation as a mediator of four predictors (discrepancy perfectionism, order perfectionism, attachment anxiety, and restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages) on intuitive eating. Three of four indirect effects were significant (discrepancy perfectionism, attachment anxiety, and restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages), while the indirect effect for order perfectionism was not significant.
section_summary.evidence_source: "We examined body appreciation as a mediator between (a) discrepancy perfectionism and intuitive eating, (b) order perfectionism and intuitive eating, (c) attachment anxiety and intuitive eating, and (d) restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages and intuitive eating." "Three of the four estimated indirect effects were significant. Body appreciation fully mediated the negative link from discrepancy perfectionism to intuitive eating (\beta = -.06, p < .01; CI = -.087 to -.033) and partially mediated the negative links from attachment anxiety to intuitive eating (\beta = -.02, p < .05; CI = -.047 to -.005) and restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages to intuitive eating (\beta = -.03, p < .05; CI = -.060 to -.007). The indirect effect from order perfectionism to body appreciation to intuitive eating was not significant (\beta = .02, p > .05; CI = -.001 to .032)."
